title: in memoriam: DORFMAn/RAUCH
program_note: This short solo ’cello work was written to honor the memory of two leaders in the world of Jewish arts, the composer Joseph Dorfman and the writer John Rauch.  I extracted melodies from the letters of both of their names; despite the seemingly large difference between the letters of their names, the melodies are remarkably similar.  I hope that this would console those who felt their loss, as I did.
